_comment_global: Global game configuration file. Comments using _comment are stripped before use.
_comment_viewport: Viewport sizes affect what is visible to the player, not the actual dungeon size.
_comment_entities: Entity configuration including player and adversary attributes.
_comment_gameplay: Core gameplay mechanics and timing configuration.
_comment_characters: Visual character representations for all game elements.
_comment_colors: Color pair assignments for curses rendering.
_comment_ui: User interface text and control mappings.

messages.invalid_input: Invalid input! Use W/A/S/D to move, Q to quit.
messages.noise_trap_player: You've hit a noise trap. The adversary is coming for you!
messages.noise_trap_adversary: The adversary triggered a noise trap! Its location is revealed for 3 ticks.
messages.trail_slowdown: You are slowed by the adversary's trail!
messages.defeat: You lose! The adversary caught you!

_comment_input: Input key mappings and movement directions.

map_config._comment: All procedural generation parameters for mapgen.
map_config._comment_tileset: Tile symbols used in mapgen and rendering.
map_config._comment_seed: Set to a number for deterministic generation; use null for random.
